rules.statement: A vendor is not liable to refund the purchase price or pay damages in a case where they only professed to sell an incertum juris acting in good faith, doubting their own right but without certain knowledge that the thing was another's. This applies even if there is an express warranty.
rules.supporting_quote: "The second defendant impressed me as an unsophisticated villager while the plaintiff obviously does not belong to the class of cultivators, though he calls himself a cultivator."
